transformations.source:
FUNCTION HasCycle(head):
    IF head IS NULL OR head.next IS NULL THEN RETURN False
    
    slow <- head
    fast <- head
    
    WHILE fast IS NOT NULL AND fast.next IS NOT NULL DO
        slow <- slow.next
        fast <- fast.next.next
        
        IF slow == fast THEN
            RETURN True
        END IF
    END WHILE
    
    RETURN False
END FUNCTION

FUNCTION HasCycle(head):
    IF head == NULL OR head.next == NULL THEN RETURN False
    
    slow <- head
    fast <- head
    
    WHILE fast != NULL AND fast.next != NULL DO
        slow <- slow.next
        fast <- fast.next.next
        
        IF slow == fast THEN
            RETURN True
        ENDIF
    ENDWHILE
    
    RETURN False
ENDFUNCTION
